text: ...Hrm? Seems you don’t have the funds to cover\nyer bid there. ’Fraid that voids the sale, kid.

label: sub_003_auctioneer_b_03
text: The highest bid stands at [VAR 0x0205(0003,002C)]!\nAnyone willing to go higher?

label: sub_003_auctioneer_b_05
text: SOLD to the savvy bidder here for [VAR 0x0205(0003,002C)]!

label: sub_003_auctioneer_b_10
text: SOLD! Well done to the young [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0403)]manlady!

label: sub_003_auctioneer_b_06
text: You topped out the bidding at [VAR 0x0205(0003,002C)]!\nHere’s your goods, dear.

label: sub_003_auctioneer_b_07
text: ...Oh? You don’t have enough money to cover\nyour bid, dear! I’ll hang onto this lot for now.

label: sub_003_auctioneer_b_08
text: Thanks so much for joining in.

label: sub_003_auctioneer_b_09
text: Oh dear... I’m sorry, young [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0403)]manlady, but I don’t\nthink our auctions are for you just yet.

label: sub_003_auctioneer_c_02
text: OK, amigos y amigas, we start at [VAR 0x0205(0003,002C)]!\nDon’t be shy, now! Bid, bid, and bid s’more!

label: sub_003_auctioneer_c_03
text: The top bid stands at [VAR 0x0205(0003,002C)]! Anyone else\nwanna jump in?

label: sub_003_auctioneer_c_05
text: [VAR 0xBD06(0000)]SOLD to the keen-eyed bidder here for\n[VAR 0x0205(0003,002C)]!

label: sub_003_auctioneer_c_10
text: SOLD to the keen-eyed muchach[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]oa!\nMuy bien hecho!

label: sub_003_auctioneer_c_07
text: ...Huh? Wait, you don’t have enough money!\n’Fraid your bid was null and void...\r\nNo goods for you!

label: sub_003_auctioneer_c_08
text: Hope to see you again, amig[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]oa!

label: sub_003_auctioneer_c_09
text: Sorry, amig[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]oa, but you need to have more bidding\nexperience to enter our auctions. Another time!

label: sub_003_auctioneer_d_03
text: [VAR 0xBD06(0000)][VAR 0x0205(0003,002C)] is the standing bid! Can I get a\nbetter\r\noffer?

label: sub_003_auctioneer_d_05
text: SOLD to a generous bidder for [VAR 0x0205(0003,002C)]!

label: sub_003_auctioneer_d_10
text: SOLD to the young student! Very well done!

label: sub_003_auctioneer_d_06
text: Thank you for your generous bid, young [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0403)]manlady.\nThat’ll be [VAR 0x0205(0003,002C)], if you please.

label: sub_003_auctioneer_d_07
text: Ah...your pocket money doesn’t cover what\nyou owe. I’ll have to cancel this sale, dear.

label: sub_003_auctioneer_d_08
text: Our stock is always of the highest quality.\nDo come and bid again, won’t you?

label: sub_003_auctioneer_d_09
text: Welcome! Care to have a look?

label: sub_003_member_a_02
text: Tch... The price just shot up...

label: sub_003_member_a_03
text: Oooh, I want this lot real bad!!!

label: sub_003_member_e_02
text: Where’d a kid get such money?

label: sub_003_member_e_03
text: Time for this old geezer to shine!

label: sub_003_member_f_03
text: I’m taking this home for sure!

label: sub_003_member_g_02
text: Hrrmph. Not bad for a young ’un!

label: sub_003_member_g_03
text: No way I’m lettin’ this lot go!

label: sub_003_member_g_04
text: Guess I’ll just head on home...

label: sub_003_member_h_03
text: Time to empty the pension pot!
